ucs.title: [LLM] INC Ransom (GOLD IONIC) staging + MEGA/rclone exfil chain
ucs.description: Catches INC Ransom's hallmark double-extortion data theft: 7-Zip/WinRAR archiving of file-share content into a staging directory, followed within the same hour by an outbound transfer using rclone, MEGAsync, or MEGAcmd to *.mega.nz endpoints. Secureworks (GOLD IONIC) and Huntress IR reporting consistently observe this exact archive-then-MEGA pattern on INC intrusions.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as archive_time values(Processes.process) as archive_cmd values(Processes.process_name) as archive_bin from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("7z.exe","7za.exe","7zg.exe","winrar.exe","rar.exe") AND (Processes.process="* a *" OR Processes.process="*-p*" OR Processes.process="*-mx*" OR Processes.process="*-v*") by Processes.dest Processes.user | rename Processes.dest as dest Processes.user as user | append [ | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as exfil_time values(All_Traffic.app) as exfil_proc values(All_Traffic.dest) as remote_host from datamodel=Network_Traffic.All_Traffic where (All_Traffic.dest IN ("*mega.nz","*mega.co.nz","*userstorage.mega.co.nz") OR All_Traffic.app IN ("rclone.exe","MEGAsync.exe","megacmd.exe","megasync.exe","MEGAcmdServer.exe")) by All_Traffic.src | rename All_Traffic.src as dest ] | stats values(archive_time) as archive_time values(archive_bin) as archive_bin values(archive_cmd) as archive_cmd values(exfil_time) as exfil_time values(exfil_proc) as exfil_proc values(remote_host) as remote_host by dest user | where isnotnull(archive_time) AND isnotnull(exfil_time) | eval delta_min = round((exfil_time - archive_time)/60, 1) | where delta_min >= 0 AND delta_min <= 60 | table dest user archive_time exfil_time delta_min archive_bin archive_cmd exfil_proc remote_host
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let WindowMinutes = 60m;
let Archives = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where FileName in~ ("7z.exe","7za.exe","7zg.exe","winrar.exe","rar.exe")
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any (" a ","-p","-mx","-v","-hp")    // archive-create flags incl. password
    | where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
    | project ArchiveTime=Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
              ArchiveBin=FileName, ArchiveCmd=ProcessCommandLine;
let Exfil = DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where RemoteIPType == "Public"
    | where (RemoteUrl has_any ("mega.nz","mega.co.nz","userstorage.mega.co.nz","megaupload.com"))
         or (InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("rclone.exe","megasync.exe","megacmd.exe","megacmdserver.exe","mega.exe"))
    | project ExfilTime=Timestamp, DeviceId, ExfilBin=InitiatingProcessFileName,
              ExfilCmd=InitiatingProcessCommandLine, RemoteIP, RemoteUrl, RemotePort;
Archives
| join kind=inner Exfil on DeviceId
| where ExfilTime between (ArchiveTime .. ArchiveTime + WindowMinutes)
| project ArchiveTime, ExfilTime,
          DeltaMin = datetime_diff('minute', ExfilTime, ArchiveTime),
          DeviceName, AccountName, ArchiveBin, ArchiveCmd,
          ExfilBin, ExfilCmd, RemoteUrl, RemoteIP, RemotePort
| order by ArchiveTime desc

Archives

| project ArchiveTime, ExfilTime,
          DeltaMin = datetime_diff('minute', ExfilTime, ArchiveTime),
          DvcHostname, ActorUsername, ArchiveBin, ArchiveCmd, Url, DstHostname, DstIpAddr
| order by ArchiveTime desc
ucs.datadog_query: source:(windows.sysmon OR windows.security) @EventID:1 (@Image:(*\\MEGAsync.exe OR *\\megasync.exe OR *\\MEGAcmd.exe OR *\\megacmd.exe OR *\\MEGAcmdServer.exe OR *\\rclone.exe OR *\\Rclone.exe OR *\\mega.exe) OR @CommandLine:(*"mega.nz"* OR *"mega.co.nz"* OR *"--remote"*"mega:"* OR *"rclone"*"copy"*"mega"*))
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ImageFileName=/\\(MEGAsync|megasync|MEGAcmd|megacmd|MEGAcmdServer|rclone|mega)\.exe$/i
| CommandLine=/(mega\.nz|mega\.co\.nz|userstorage\.mega|--remote|mega:|copy.*mega|sync.*mega)/i
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ImageFileName], function={collect([CommandLine]), min(_time), max(_time)})
ucs.rationale: MEGA + 7-Zip/WinRAR is INC Ransom's signature double-extortion pattern (Secureworks GOLD IONIC, Huntress, SentinelLabs reporting). Other ransomware crews favor rclone-to-S3 (BlackBasta) or Mega via Filezilla (LockBit) — but INC consistently chains a password-protected archive under a staging path with a same-hour MEGA upload from the same host. ucs.title: [LLM] INC Ransom impact bundle: shadow-copy wipe + backup-service kill + .inc file writes
ucs.description: Catches the INC Ransom encryptor's pre-impact sequence within a tight window: vssadmin/wmic/wbadmin shadow & catalog deletion, taskkill/net stop against SQL/Veeam/backup services, followed by mass file writes with the .inc extension and INC-README.txt/INC-README.html ransom-note drops. This three-leg correlation is unique to INC Ransom (G1032 / GOLD IONIC) and fires before encryption completes.
ucs.splunk: (| tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as first_time max(_time) as last_time values(Processes.process_name) as procs values(Processes.process) as cmd_lines from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where ((Processes.process_name="vssadmin.exe" Processes.process="*delete shadows*") OR (Processes.process_name="wmic.exe" Processes.process="*shadowcopy delete*") OR (Processes.process_name="wbadmin.exe" Processes.process="*delete catalog*") OR (Processes.process_name IN ("net.exe","net1.exe") (Processes.process="*stop MSSQL*" OR Processes.process="*stop Veeam*" OR Processes.process="*stop Backup*" OR Processes.process="*stop SQLAgent*")) OR (Processes.process_name="taskkill.exe" (Processes.process="*sqlservr*" OR Processes.process="*veeam*" OR Processes.process="*backup*"))) by Processes.dest Processes.user | rename Processes.dest as dest Processes.user as user) | append [ | tstats summariesonly=true count as enc_count min(_time) as enc_first values(Filesystem.file_path) as enc_paths from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where (Filesystem.file_name="*.inc" OR Filesystem.file_name="INC-README.txt" OR Filesystem.file_name="INC-README.html") by Filesystem.dest | rename Filesystem.dest as dest ] | stats values(*) as * by dest user | where isnotnull(first_time) AND isnotnull(enc_first) AND mvcount(procs) >= 2 AND (enc_first - first_time) <= 1800 AND (enc_first - first_time) >= 0 | table dest user first_time last_time enc_first enc_count procs cmd_lines enc_paths
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let WindowMinutes = 30m;
let ShadowKill = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where (FileName =~ "vssadmin.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "delete shadows")
         or (FileName =~ "wmic.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "shadowcopy delete")
         or (FileName =~ "wbadmin.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "delete catalog")
         or (FileName =~ "bcdedit.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("recoveryenabled no","bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures"))
    | project ShadowTime=Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName, ShadowCmd=ProcessCommandLine;
let ServiceStop = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where (FileName in~ ("net.exe","net1.exe","sc.exe") and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("stop MSSQL","stop Veeam","stop Backup","stop SQLAgent","stop MSExchange"))
         or (FileName =~ "taskkill.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("sqlservr","veeam","backup","vmms"))
    | project StopTime=Timestamp, DeviceId, StopCmd=ProcessCommandLine;
let IncWrite = DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where ActionType == "FileCreated"
    | where (FileName endswith ".inc") or (FileName in~ ("INC-README.txt","INC-README.html"))
    | summarize EncFirst=min(Timestamp), EncCount=count(), SampleFile=any(FolderPath) by DeviceId;
ShadowKill
| join kind=inner ServiceStop on DeviceId
| where StopTime between (ShadowTime - WindowMinutes .. ShadowTime + WindowMinutes)
| join kind=inner IncWrite on DeviceId
| where EncFirst between (ShadowTime - WindowMinutes .. ShadowTime + WindowMinutes)
| project ShadowTime, StopTime, EncFirst, EncCount,
          DeviceName, AccountName, ShadowCmd, StopCmd, SampleFile
| order by ShadowTime desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let WindowMinutes = 30m;
let ImpactProcs = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | where (NewProcessName endswith @"\vssadmin.exe" and CommandLine has "delete shadows")
         or (NewProcessName endswith @"\wmic.exe" and CommandLine has "shadowcopy delete")
         or (NewProcessName endswith @"\wbadmin.exe" and CommandLine has "delete catalog")
         or (NewProcessName endswith @"\bcdedit.exe" and CommandLine has_any ("recoveryenabled no","bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures"))
         or (NewProcessName endswith_cs @"\net.exe" and CommandLine has_any ("stop MSSQL","stop Veeam","stop Backup","stop SQLAgent"))
         or (NewProcessName endswith @"\taskkill.exe" and CommandLine has_any ("sqlservr","veeam","backup"))
    | extend Leg = case(
        CommandLine has_any ("delete shadows","shadowcopy delete","delete catalog","recoveryenabled no"), "recovery",
        CommandLine has_any ("stop ","sqlservr","veeam","backup"), "servicestop",
        "other");
ImpactProcs
| summarize
    Legs = make_set(Leg),
    LegCount = dcount(Leg),
    FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated),
    LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated),
    Cmdlines = make_set(CommandLine, 20),
    Procs = make_set(NewProcessName, 20)
    by Computer, SubjectUserName, Bucket=bin(TimeGenerated, WindowMinutes)
| where LegCount >= 2 and Legs has "recovery" and Legs has "servicestop"
| extend WindowSec = datetime_diff('second', LastSeen, FirstSeen)
| order by FirstSeen desc

title: INC Ransom Pre-Encryption Impact Commands (GOLD IONIC)
id: 7a3f1c20-4b91-4a55-9e0e-fcae4a7e0001
status: experimental
description: Detects shadow copy / backup catalog deletion and SQL/Veeam/backup service stops characteristic of INC Ransom (G1032 / GOLD IONIC) impact phase prior to encryption.
references:
  - https://www.secureworks.com/research/gold-ionic-deploys-inc-ransomware
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1032/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/18
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  vss_delete:
    Image|endswith: '\vssadmin.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'delete'
      - 'shadows'
  wmic_delete:
    Image|endswith: '\wmic.exe'
    CommandLine|contains: 'shadowcopy delete'
  wbadmin_delete:
    Image|endswith: '\wbadmin.exe'
    CommandLine|contains: 'delete catalog'
  bcdedit_disable:
    Image|endswith: '\bcdedit.exe'
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'recoveryenabled no'
      - 'bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures'
  service_stop:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\net.exe'
      - '\net1.exe'
      - '\sc.exe'
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'stop MSSQL'
      - 'stop Veeam'
      - 'stop Backup'
      - 'stop SQLAgent'
      - 'stop MSExchange'
  taskkill_backup:
    Image|endswith: '\taskkill.exe'
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'sqlservr'
      - 'veeam'
      - 'backup'
  condition: 1 of *
falsepositives:
  - Backup administrators rotating shadow copies during planned maintenance
  - SQL DBA stopping services for patching (correlate with change-control)
level: high
tags:
  - attack.impact
  - attack.t1490
  - attack.t1489
  - attack.t1486
  - attack.g1032

| (ImageFileName=/\\vssadmin\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/delete\s+shadows/i)

  OR (ImageFileName=/\\wbadmin\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/delete\s+catalog/i)
